extractions.value: Patient had metastatic breast cancer (diagnosed 2010) with bone metastases and pathologic fracture of C2 vertebral body (2011). History of chronic right-sided back pain, sciatica, and 'dystonic contractions' of back muscles secondary to 1982 motor vehicle accident, treated with paraspinal botulinum toxin injections, opioids, and gabapentin. In 11/17, nighttime 'limb jerking' deemed likely hypnogogic movements. In 4/18, worsened 'twitching' causing her to drop items, thought related to gabapentin which was discontinued. In 5/19, developed multiple and prolonged debilitating painful facial spasms with no alteration in consciousness; facial contortions marked with severe jaw clenching resulting in broken teeth. CT head, MRI brain and total spine, EEG, and CSF analysis performed; imaging negative, EEG no seizure, CSF nonspecific elevation of IgG, cytology negative for malignancy. Initial paraneoplastic autoantibody panel negative. Repeat anti-GAD antibody positive (69 IU/mL), decreased to <5 IU/mL three weeks post-plasma exchange. Rituximab given 5/19; plasma exchanges given; botulinum toxin injections advised for dystonia but deferred due to startle responses. Metaxalone added with transient decrease in spasms. Patient developed depressed mood and reluctance to leave home; referred to psychiatrist. Registered with Florida Medical Marijuana program; used CBD/THC 1:1 20 mg tincture twice per day and 83 mg CBD oil along gum line several times a day; reported marked minimization of stiffness and intensity/frequency of spasm episodes, no adverse side effects, feeling optimistic and calmer. Stopped metaxalone and scheduled botulinum toxin injections to paraspinal muscles only.
